booking.title: Booking
booking.summary: An appointment booking made by a customer for a service at a given time slot.
booking.description: A customer appointment booking. The customer's canonical identity is the linked contact entity (linkedContactId); the customerName/customerEmail/customerPhone fields are a denormalised snapshot of the customer PII at booking time and are the fields pseudonymised on an AVG right-to-be-forgotten request. Booking records are retained for the NL Boekhoudplicht 7-year period and are never auto-deleted.

linkedContactId.description: UUID of the canonical customer contact entity in the pipelinq register (ADR-022: a customer is a Nextcloud/contact entity, never invented).

customerName.description: Denormalised customer name snapshot; pseudonymised (SHA-256) on right-to-be-forgotten.

customerEmail.description: Denormalised customer email snapshot; pseudonymised (SHA-256) on right-to-be-forgotten.

customerPhone.description: Denormalised customer phone snapshot; pseudonymised (SHA-256) on right-to-be-forgotten.

resource.description: UUID of the assigned resource/staff member.

status.description: Booking lifecycle status. Terminal statuses (completed/cancelled/no-show) are retained, never purged.

depositAmount.description: Deposit amount in the smallest currency unit (retained as an aggregate).

pseudonymized.description: True once the customer PII on this booking has been pseudonymised under AVG right-to-be-forgotten.
